history.summary: A 452sqft freehold shoebox 1BR at Viento, D14, asking $1,582 psf — essentially at the $1,593 URA median — for a low $715k absolute. Strong $/psf value with a ~6%/yr rate, but on only 14 transactions and 760m from Dakota MRT, so it is a sensibly-priced niche shoebox rather than a conviction buy.
history.rating_rationale: The cheapest entry in the batch at $715k, fairly priced at-median, freehold, in a Paya Lebar Central / airbase-relocation district — all positives. But it's a 452sqft shoebox (niche buyer pool), the 6%/yr appreciation rests on a thin 14-txn series, and 760m to Dakota is a moderate walk. Fair value with a clear yield angle; not enough conviction or data depth to upgrade past Neutral.
red_flags: Only 14 URA txn — appreciation rate low-confidence
catalysts: Freehold tenure at a low $715k entry

history.summary: Small freehold Geylang 1BR priced at market, not below it — freehold is not a forward edge and the cheap signal does not survive verification.
history.rating_rationale: The algo flags -15.9% age-adj value, but that is the freehold age-adjustment doing the work, not a real discount: this 452-sqft unit at S$1,582 psf sits right on Viento's recent transaction average of ~S$1,593 psf, consistent with the +6.0% vs-cohort premium. Both the appreciation (6.24% CAGR) and cohort rest on only 14 transactions — a tiny, illiquid 48-unit boutique block — so the high CAGR is a low-confidence data point, not a momentum signal. Freehold tenure is not a forward edge per the v3.4 priors. No MRT integration (Dakota/Aljunied a walk away), small floor plate, and D14 Geylang carries a perception/financing discount. Fairly priced with no decisive catalyst → Neutral.
red_flags: Only ~14 transactions / 48-unit boutique block — thin liquidity makes both the CAGR and the value read low-confidence
Geylang (D14) location carries lender LTV caution and resale-perception drag
Priced essentially at recent market average — no margin of safety
catalysts: Freehold tenure (durability, not a forward price edge)
Paya Lebar regional centre redevelopment is a broad area tailwind, not unit-specific
